title: Zombie Apocalypse Kit (March 2024)
author: Quaternius
notes: source/ is the download as it came (Characters, Environment, Vehicles, Weapons), untouched except that Godot's generated .import files were removed. It carries a .gdignore: Godot never imports it. Nothing builds from it any more: every model a tool uses is copied into blends/, so source/ can be deleted (keep License.txt, which is at the kit root too).

TrafficLight_2_Japan.blend is Quaternius' TrafficLight_2 re-made as a Japanese signal by the project owner (horizontal green-yellow-red head, pedestrian head on the pole). It is the owner of the signal's shape.

pieces/props/ is GENERATED by blender/tools/build_street_poles.py: the signal scaled to Japanese clearances (vehicle head lower edge 4.7 m, pedestrian head 2.5 m), the street lamp's shaft stretched to a 10 m luminaire, and a twin-arm median lamp. Never edit it by hand.
materials/ are hand-owned MI_*.tres that WorldBaker resolves by the glTF material name; textures/Zombie_Atlas.png is the kit's one atlas.

pieces/yard/ + pieces.json are GENERATED by blender/tools/build_zombie_yard.py: containers fitted to ISO 668 (20 ft, and 40 ft stretched), pallet, drum, cone, plastic barrier, tyre stack, for the composite sites (the container terminal). Never edit by hand.
blends/ holds the download's .blend files the tools build from (StreetLights for the lamp; Container_Red/Green, Pallet, Barrel, TrafficCone_1, PlasticBarrier, Wheels_Stack for the yard), untouched.
